desc: Compute prefix distinct pre[i] and suffix distinct suf[j] in O(N) using occurrence markers.
Compute previous occurrence prev[k] via a single left-to-right scan with a last[] array.
Build a difference-array segment tree storing per-node (sum, max_prefix) for O(log N) point update and prefix-max query.
Sweep j from 1 to N-1 applying the suffix-add and querying prefix max over i in [1,j-1] to update the answer.
Verify against Sample 1 (5), Sample 2 (9), and hand-checked edge cases; worker reported all samples PASSED.
